meta.title: Fix issue 2279: Prevent multiple OtelBatchSpanProcessor threads
meta.body_summary: Implement singleton pattern for Telemetry class to ensure OtelBatchSpanProcessor is initialized only once, preventing excessive thread creation and memory leaks.

perf_labels.notes: Devin implemented Telemetry singleton; joaomdmoura AI review suggested threading and cleanup improvements; no further engagement, closed stale.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 202 changed lines across 2 files, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume. The PR was closed without merge due to inactivity, not because of change scale.

review_details.concern_detail: AI reviewer joaomdmoura identified potential race conditions in the singleton __new__ and recommended using threading.Lock; also suggested resource cleanup via __del__ and better documentation.
review_details.performance_claim: Prevent excessive thread creation and memory leaks by ensuring only one OtelBatchSpanProcessor is created.
review_details.rejection_signals: AI reviewer comment had suggestions but no explicit block; PR closed by Devin bot after 7+ days without further commits or response.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent could potentially implement the suggested improvements but did not; the PR stalled and was auto-closed.

detection_detail.code_reading: joaomdmoura (via AI crew) reviewed the singleton pattern and identified thread safety issues, resource cleanup needs, and documentation gaps.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark, profiling, or metric evidence provided; only narrative claim of thread reduction.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed after 7+ days of inactivity; no further commits addressing review suggestions.

core_change_summary.description: Introduced singleton pattern for Telemetry class using __new__ with _instance and _initialized flags to prevent multiple OtelBatchSpanProcessor initializations. Added test file for singleton behavior.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test file validates singleton and thread safety aspects; no performance test.
